Agent is a guest on the upgrade target and must hand off, never execute in-session or via the host's own tool worker; ordered external procedure stops the host first, pinned install, restart, browser refresh, verify; explicitly frames stop-first and version pinning as established rules with in-target refusal as the additional self-host rule.

Guard compares the command's write-target set (package path + bin dir) with the session's own runtime root and hard-blocks on intersection; alpha.5→rc.1 diff (252 version-bump files, zero API changes) → no plugin re-migration; checklist verifies version markers, shim state, host start + hard refresh + actual plugin load, backups cleaned only after confirmation; conclusions scoped to these tags.
